collection_notes: A search result titled as an OregonLive candidate profile for Savage was hosted on an unrelated domain (community.peacecorpsconnect.org) and was excluded as a red-flag mirror. Incumbency left null (no official source); inventory had false. Judicial candidate: bio/qualifications only; no issue positions sought. Voters' pamphlet: Book 13 lists 4th District judges on pp. 59-61, but the PDF text is cut off by the fetch tool at ~120k characters (p. 49), so judicial statements could not be read; oregonvotes.gov military voters' guide pages surfaced by search for Sykes and Hagedorn redirect to the SOS elections home page (302), so they were not usable. Step 5 ran with allowed_domains limited to opb.org, wweek.com, portlandmercury.com because the proxy rejected longer domain lists. Bio items from WW's April 2026 endorsement piece are descriptive facts only; no endorsement content is used.
